fields.name: What does Bun2Too help businesses build?
fields.question: What does Bun2Too help businesses build?
fields.answer: Bun2Too helps businesses build and operate AI applications through forward-deployed engineering and AI infrastructure setup. Our customer technology services cover customer data platforms (CDP) and integrations, customer identity and access management (CIAM), analytics and AI automation, and consent and communication preferences.

fields.name: What is AI forward-deployed engineering?
fields.question: What is AI forward-deployed engineering?
fields.answer: It means working alongside a business team to turn a concrete problem into a working AI application. Bun2Too helps with RAG and agent workflows, integration into existing systems, evaluation, deployment, and iteration based on operational needs.

fields.name: Can Bun2Too help set up AI infrastructure and environments?
fields.question: Can Bun2Too help set up AI infrastructure and environments?
fields.answer: Yes. Bun2Too helps set up cloud or self-hosted AI environments, including model serving, retrieval and vector data stores, secure access, deployment pipelines, observability, and cost controls. The setup is designed around the business's requirements and how its team will operate it.

fields.name: How are customer data platforms and customer identity connected?
fields.question: How are customer data platforms and customer identity connected?
fields.answer: A customer data platform brings together customer signals from business systems. CIAM manages how customers sign in and access accounts. Bun2Too designs the integration between these systems so identity, customer context, and consent can work together.

fields.name: How do I sign in or create a Bun2Too account?
fields.question: How do I sign in or create a Bun2Too account?
fields.answer: Open My account and choose Log in or Create an account. Auth0 manages authentication. If you requested email updates without a password, use Continue with email and the same email address to access that passwordless identity.

fields.name: Does creating an account subscribe me to email updates?
fields.question: Does creating an account subscribe me to email updates?
fields.answer: No. Newsletter signup requires a separate choice. A request stays pending until the email address is verified and the subscription topics are confirmed in your account. You can change topics or unsubscribe there.

fields.name: Where can I read Bun2Too articles?
fields.question: Where can I read Bun2Too articles?
fields.answer: Visit Insights for Bun2Too field notes about AI, engineering, and customer technology. The Insights hub offers RSS and Atom feeds, as well as optional update subscriptions.

fields.name: How can I ask for help or discuss a project?
fields.question: How can I ask for help or discuss a project?
fields.answer: Read our support FAQs or open Contact Bun2Too to send a private inquiry with your contact email and a description of what you need. Sending an inquiry does not subscribe you to marketing.
